svg.title: Tanjim Al Islam — Full-Stack Developer
svg.desc: Profile card for Tanjim Al Islam: Computer Science and Engineering student at North South University in Dhaka, building full-stack web apps with a focus on blockchain and AI/ML for healthcare. Core stack: C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, Vercel. Featured project: PROJECT-EHR, tamper-evident electronic health records (lead developer). Open to software engineering internships.

g.text: Computer Science & Engineering student at North South
University, building full-stack web apps with a focus on
blockchain and AI/ML for secure, useful healthcare data.
SHA-256 hash-chained medical records, role-based dashboards
React · Vite · Tailwind · PHP · MySQL · AI risk module
Open to Software Engineering internships · Blockchain & AI/ML roles
